slug: 2025-12-10 Chad Finalizes Digital Law to Align National Framework With Global Standards

facts.fact: Ecofin reports the government recently presented a national strategy, Chad Connection 2030, outlining $1.5 billion in planned digital investment and digitisation of all public services; adoption is not stated.
Ecofin reports the Chad Connection 2030 strategy aims to raise Chad's economic standing within six years.
